prompt:
Build a one-lap kinetic-energy-recovery model for a high-performance vehicle. Read kers_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate for at most 100 s; the lap may stop when it is complete, but a valid lap must last between 80 and 100 s. kers_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: strategy_mode is an integer scalar, with 0 using available KERS assistance at all acceleration opportunities and 1 using it only at selected high-value opportunities; battery_mass_kg is a real scalar in 0.5--3.0 kg; ultracapacitor_mass_kg is a real scalar in 1.0--8.0 kg; and motor_generator_mass_kg is a real scalar in 3.0--6.0 kg. The physical system must include longitudinal vehicle dynamics, a rear-axle motor-generator, a shared DC bus, a lithium-ion battery, and an ultracapacitor. Braking must drive regenerative electrical power into the hybrid store, and acceleration assistance must return stored energy through the motor-generator.

Use the three mass fields as real design inputs: storage energy/power capability, electrical response, motor torque capability, and total vehicle mass must respond causally to them. The battery should supply energy-oriented support while the ultracapacitor carries the higher transient power. The strategy must alter actual motor torque and storage-current behavior, not only a displayed mode flag.

Log five complete-run MATLAB Timeseries with these exact public channel contracts and units. vehicle_speed has width 1: vehicle_speed_kph, in km/h. traction has width 3 in this order: motor_torque_Nm in N*m, motor_speed_rad_s in rad/s, motor_mechanical_power_W in W. storage_voltage has width 3 in this order: battery_voltage_V, ultracapacitor_voltage_V, dc_bus_voltage_V, all in V. storage_current has width 2 in this order: battery_current_A, ultracapacitor_current_A, both in A. storage_power has width 2 in this order: battery_power_W, ultracapacitor_power_W, both in W. Each log must begin at 0 s, remain finite, and reach the lap-completion time. Battery and ultracapacitor currents and powers must come from their physical energy paths, with signs that distinguish charging from discharging. Hard-coded scenario traces, copied scalar inputs, disconnected storage branches, fabricated Timeseries, or strategy signals that do not affect the physical power path are not acceptable. Save the completed model as cand_XBATT08.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XBATT08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
